name: @joshski/dust
description: Flow state for AI coding agents
author: joshski

scripts.build: bun build lib/cli/run.ts --target node --outfile dist/dust.js && printf '%s\n%s' '#!/usr/bin/env node' "$(cat dist/dust.js)" > dist/dust.js && bun build lib/workflow-tasks.ts --target node --outfile dist/workflow-tasks.js && bunx tsc --project tsconfig.build.json && rm -rf templates && cp -r lib/templates templates
